reuse.why: Fintegra reuses linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, and unlinking shares clearAccountLink, but transaction downloading copies Akahu's implementation.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions duplicates the authentication, request, error handling and response mapping already present in downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Link policies remain in the shared account-linking workflow, provider downloads remain in sync.ts, and provider models and URLs follow existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested linking policies, Fintegra integration, associated tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Centralized link validation and link clearing are maintainable, but the copied downloader and local extension of the canonical provider type create competing definitions to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts extends LinkBankSyncAccountParams.syncSource with AccountSyncSource | 'fintegra' instead of extending the shared provider definition in types/models/bank-sync.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts adds downloadFintegraTransactions as a provider-renamed copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, changing only the provider log label and server configuration property.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and branches for closed targets, duplicate-link refusal and clearing the previous holder; every provider still delegates linking to this helper.
